name: jastrow
description: Jastrow Dictionary PWA — vanilla-JS static site, plus the local-only admin server and Rabbinic Time PDF builder under data/admin.

scripts.qa: bun qa:format && bun qa:lint; bun qa:test; bun qa:tsc
scripts.setup:pdf: bun data/admin/pdf-builds/stage.ts && bun x playwright install chromium

comment: chart.js is pinned to match the CDN <script> in index.html and the @biomejs/biome pin matches .mise.toml — bump them together. Chromium for the PDF builder is NOT installed on `bun install`; run `bun run setup:pdf` for that.
